thread:
kevin: Quick follow-up from the recent postmortem - pattern of recurring KV evictions during bursts. Need to lock owners for tests and timelines.

leah: Agree. Split into: regression promptset, targeted load profile, chaos drill runbook, and deploy gating + dashboards.

omar: I'll own the regression promptset and the eval job. Plan: 30 prompts covering single-turn cache hits, long-context cache reliance, and embed-batch. Will add under regress/kv-evict-2026 and wire up evals/kv-evict-regress. Due 2026-04-11.

nina: I'll take load profile + chaos runbook pilot. Load will be k6 with Zipfian hot-key skew. Runbook will include staging pilot and rollback thresholds. Pilot scheduled 2026-04-13 19:00 UTC.

kevin: For gating, SRE should add an automatic blocker if fallback_rate > 1% in 5m post-deploy. Who can own dashboard tiles and metrics instrumentation?

leah: I can do dashboards and alerts. I'll add tiles for kv_eviction.count and model_fallback.count with model_variant labels. Dashboard PR due 2026-04-08.

omar: Draft eval config I'll use in CI: name=kv-evict-regress, promptset=regress/kv-evict-2026, metrics=[latency_p95,fallback_rate], fail_if_fallback_pct>0.5%. Will open PR tonight.

nina: Runbook sketch: enable eviction sim, run k6 burst (6m), observe fallback and latency p95/p99, disable sim. Rollback if fallback > 2%. Will add synthetic that runs every 5m to surface regressions early.

kevin: Good. Acceptance criteria: eval exists + runs in CI, load profile documented, chaos pilot executed, gating in pipeline, dashboards + alerts. Once PRs are linked I'll move items to the postmortem board.

leah: :white_check_mark: I'll drop the dashboard PR link when ready.

omar: :white_check_mark: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/rls-evals/pull/510

nina: :white_check_mark: Runbook PR: https://git.internal/redwood/runbooks/pull/224

sre-bot: Note: please add `postmortem-followup` label to PRs for tracking and board sync.

kevin: Thanks team. Revisit in next SRE sync. Closing thread after PR merges and pilot run.
